opening: I have a bad feeling about this...
note: Decision 88: the door runs on the labels (the labels file, data/labels.json). One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film sits under every kind it is labelled with; a film not yet labelled waits behind the door under "anything" and "Just pick one!" only. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered. The spies answer speaks Thriller's spies reply and self-destructs with it.

questions.ask: so, what are we up against?

options.say: superheroes. capes, powers, and saving the world before dinner.
options.reply: cue the superhero landing. terrible for the knees.

options.say: skip the speeches. let the fists do the talking.
options.reply: peace was never really an option.

options.say: one against an army. hardly seems fair.
options.reply: I know. they really should've brought more.

options.say: spies, secret agents, and international intrigue. give me the briefing.
options.reply: your assignment is classified. this message will self-destruct in five seconds.

options.say: give me a broken future or a distant galaxy, and something worth fighting over.
options.reply: tomorrow appears to be heavily armed.

options.say: give me a map and send me on a quest.
options.reply: pack light. we're not coming back for anything.

options.say: disaster, survival, and everything going very wrong.
options.reply: I have the situation completely under control.

options.say: put me on the front lines. I want the war up close.
I want the bullets flying and the jokes landing.
options.reply: I'll find one where nobody ever reloads.

options.say: give me fast cars, big chases, and a very capable driver.

superheroes.note: shared with the scifi and fantasy and animation doors, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

martial_arts.note: fight-heavy films: martial arts, swords and blades, brawls and long fights, not martial arts alone.

spies.note: shared with the thriller door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

war_battle.note: shared with the war door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

action_comedy.note: shared with the comedy door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

cars.note: films where driving, racing or the chase is the main event: street racing, getaway drivers, motor racing, chases on wheels.
